`manual-example.txt` is `DOC/installer.txt` from Igor Pavlov's LZMA SDK 26.02
release, copied verbatim to preserve the documentation false positive. The
official SDK page describes its source and sample tools as public domain:
https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html

`build.bat` mirrors the SDK's `bin/installer/cr.bat` source line. The FTP
fixture is inert command text used to verify the `!copy` local-shell case.
